# Metadatapp

> Open-source FAIR-by-design metadata management platform for biomedical and preclinical research, combining a Symfony/API Platform backend, the Osoma React frontend, and server-side integrations with external laboratory systems.

This file helps LLMs and AI agents discover the repository's machine- and
human-readable declarations.

## Declarations

- [AI Declaration](./AI-declaration.md): repository uses AI (agents, prompts, models, or MCP)
- [FAIR Declaration](./FAIR.md): repository manages or describes research data
- [TRUST Declaration](./TRUST.md): repository performs AI knowledge management (MCP/RAG, prompt/eval corpora, governed knowledge base)
- [Design Declaration](./design.md): repository ships a frontend / design system

## Machine metadata

- [Citation metadata](./CITATION.cff): repository is citable software
- [CodeMeta software metadata](./codemeta.json): repository is software with FAIR metadata

## Index

- [Machine-readable index](./.well-known/repo-declarations.json)
